overview: This Senate resolution honors six Air Force service members killed on March 12, 2026, when a KC-135 Stratotanker, a plane used to refuel other aircraft in flight, crashed over western Iraq while supporting Operation Epic Fury. Three served with an Air National Guard refueling squadron in Birmingham, Alabama, and three with an Air National Guard refueling wing in Columbus, Ohio. The Senate honors their sacrifice, offers condolences to their families, and asks that copies be sent to both units. It was approved on March 23, 2026.
for: Supporters say the Senate should formally recognize service members who died supporting U.S. military operations and honor their families.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending, though tributes like this are rarely opposed.
